notes.localization: Cards reference stringsEN.json by name_key and description_key instead of duplicating localized text.
notes.values: Card mechanics were extracted from the cCards constructor calls in the ASM files.
notes.arrays: Numeric fields are kept as per-effect arrays because cCards stores them that way.
notes.active_selection: Active encounter membership is based on sMonsterList.asm: monstersForest plus the fixed/special forest placements in define_list.
notes.unused: Unused forest scripts are retained separately because they exist in Assembly but are not placed into the Demo forest encounter list by sMonsterList.asm.
